ORGANIZER SERVICES
Credits, memberships, and resources
Refresh

Rates: Cash $10.00 setup + $5–$1/hour while the table is active; tournament $5.00 setup + $1.00 rescheduling; Spin & Go $3.00 setup + $1.00 rescheduling. Membership costs $9.00 per calendar month.

Credit billing is not active on this installation. Debit controls are disabled and existing hosting continues in legacy mode.
